name: Westvale Abbey // Ormendahl, Profane Prince

abilities.text: {5}, {T}, Pay 1 life: Create a 1/1 white and black Human Cleric creature token.
{5}, {T}, Sacrifice five creatures: Transform ~, then untap it.

notes: The flip is the transform op with untap:true, which is exactly 'Transform this land, then untap it.' Ormendahl's only line is a keyword line, claimed by the back face's keywords.

issues: {5}, {T}, Pay 1 life: Create a 1/1 white and black Human Cleric creature token. — expected a token named "Human Cleric", 1/1, both white and black, subtypes Human and Cleric; 1 life paid as a cost — scripted cost {mana:{5}, tap, payLife:1} and token 1/1 colors ['W','B'] subtypes ['Human','Cleric'] — all correct; the blind run confirms life 20->19 and one create-token event. The single scenario failure is only that the token is unaddressable: with `name` omitted the engine calls it "Human Cleric token" (game.ts:1379) while CR 111.4 makes its name "Human Cleric". Corpus-wide convention (parse.ts:747), shared with Legion's Landing, so not scored against this script. — CR 111.4

{5}, {T}, Sacrifice five creatures: Transform this land, then untap it. — expected exactly five creatures you control sacrificed as a cost (the Abbey itself, a land, is not eligible); then transform and untap — scripted sacrificeMany {filter:{types:['Creature']},count:5} — cost-alter.ts:409 draws candidates from pl.battlefield, i.e. only the activating player's own creatures, and the land cannot match a Creature filter. transform {target:'self', untap:true} flips then setTapped(false) in that order (transform.ts:288-294). Blind run confirms five creatures in the graveyard and the permanent untapped. Correct. — CR 701.27a / 118.3

// Flying, lifelink, indestructible, haste — expected the back face Ormendahl, Profane Prince is a 9/7 Legendary Creature — Demon with all four keywords — scripted backFace.keywords carries all four and backFace.abilities is empty, which is right; the 9/7 and the type line come from the card DB, not the script (scripts.ts:1532 applyFace only replaces abilities/keywords). Blind run confirms all four keywords and that Ormendahl's flying refuses a ground blocker. — CR 702.9b / 702.15a / 702.12b / 702.10b
